 Order

The petitioners seek quashing of FIR No. 623/2022 dated 21.12.2022, registered at police station Amar Colony for the offences under Section 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC')
including the proceedings emanating therefrom, on the ground that no cause of action has arisen in New Delhi and the FIR was registered solely for the reason of pressurizing the petitioners.
2. It is the case of the petitioner that the marriage of petitioner no.1 and the complainant was solemnized in Dubai, pursuant to which they also reside in Dubai.
3. The learned counsel for the petitioner relies on the certificate issued by the Gurudwara in Dubai in regard to the marriage between petitioner no.1 and the complainant.
It is also pointed out that the parties have also obtained divorce from the
